title: Tall Pines Campground

services.name: Deluxe Cabins
services.desc: We have 8 Primitive Cabins for nightly (2 night minimum), weekend and weekly rental. One Primitive Cabin is Pet-Friendly (PC1), there is a limit of two dogs and additional fees apply per pet per night. Each Primitive Cabin includes 1 Double bed , 3 twin bunk beds which sleeps 5 with room on the floor for 1 more if you bring air mattress or sleeping bags. Rate includes 4 people. MAX 6 people. Includes A/C and Heat. 3.4 cu ft. Microfridge with Microwave. NO BATHROOM FACILITIES. Bathroom facilities are just a close walk away. Primitive Cabins come with a picnic table, charcoal grill, and a fire ring. Gas grills are not permitted on Cabin
